inputs.note: Proved, but not here. The write-back branch's WriteBackServiceTest::testAFailureAfterTheDocumentIsStoredWritesNothingAndLeavesNoOrphanFile asserts BOTH halves — zero ledger rows survive the rollback AND the stored ciphertext file is deleted — and ::testADocumentThatWasAlreadyStoredIsNeverDiscarded asserts the rollback does not delete bytes the call did not write. Those are PHPUnit tests against faked collaborators; this gate is Python and its CI image has no PHP. Activating this case would mean either a second CI job on a PHP image, or a recorded transcript fixture the Python side replays. Neither is built, and asserting a weaker Python-side property here while claiming the case is active would be worse than leaving it pending.

expected: A partial failure mid-write leaves no ledger row and no orphaned ciphertext file on disk. Both are asserted; the document and the whole procedure_order -> procedure_result chain commit together or not at all.
guards_against: Orphan rows: results pointing at a document that was never stored, or a document with results that never arrived.
